preconditions.description: The number of queries N must be between 1 and 100,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= i <= 10**9 and 1 <= j <= 10**9 for i, j in queries)
preconditions.description: Each query must contain two integers i and j, both between 1 and 1,000,000,000.

postconditions.description: The output must be the distances for each query, separated by newlines.
